title: Bathe in an Alaskan geothermal spring
description: Watch steam rise into freezing air while snow surrounds the outdoor pool. The contrast between warm water and the winter landscape is the main pleasure.
teaser: Watch steam rise into freezing air while snow surrounds the outdoor pool.
goodToKnow: Before you go, check hot-water suitability, pool access and slippery footing.
